analyst_view.overall: Early view: Tenerife are still playing in the shadow of striker Jesús de Miguel's death after the 2 November match with Andorra; Álvaro Cervera's side have drawn four in a row and their home games have been low-scoring. Eldense, under Javi Calleja, drew 0-0 at Las Palmas on Monday and have scored only four goals in seven away games. Dani Martín's ban should be served against Ceuta on 15 November.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. I lean lower: Tenerife's home games have averaged two goals and Eldense's away games under two, with the 0-0 at Las Palmas the latest example.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. I lean lower: Tenerife won no corners against Andorra and Eldense only one at Las Palmas, and neither side keeps the ball for long spells in the final third.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards. I lean higher: Eldense picked up six yellows and committed 21 fouls at Las Palmas, and Tenerife had three yellows and a red against Andorra.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.4 shots. I lean lower: Tenerife took five shots against Andorra and Eldense six at Las Palmas, so neither side produces much volume.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.9 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Tenerife had two on target against Andorra and Eldense one at Las Palmas.
